VGLOW.Settings.enableSheets.Name: Tint actor sheets
VGLOW.Settings.enableSheets.Hint: Tint magic item rows on pf1 character, NPC, and loot sheets, and inside container items.
VGLOW.Settings.enablePiles.Name: Tint Item Piles
VGLOW.Settings.enablePiles.Hint: Tint magic item rows in Item Piles windows of type pile. Merchants, vaults, and containers stay untouched.
VGLOW.Settings.colorUnidentified.Name: Unidentified color
VGLOW.Settings.colorUnidentified.Hint: Row tint for any unidentified item, whatever its aura.
VGLOW.Settings.colorFaint.Name: Faint aura color
VGLOW.Settings.colorFaint.Hint: Row tint for identified items with a faint aura, caster level 1 to 5.
VGLOW.Settings.colorModerate.Name: Moderate aura color
VGLOW.Settings.colorModerate.Hint: Row tint for identified items with a moderate aura, caster level 6 to 11.
VGLOW.Settings.colorStrong.Name: Strong aura color
VGLOW.Settings.colorStrong.Hint: Row tint for identified items with a strong aura, caster level 12 to 20.
VGLOW.Settings.colorOverwhelming.Name: Overwhelming aura color
VGLOW.Settings.colorOverwhelming.Hint: Row tint for identified items with an overwhelming aura, caster level 21 and above.
VGLOW.Settings.alpha.Name: Tint opacity
VGLOW.Settings.alpha.Hint: How strong the row tint is. Unidentified rows draw a little stronger so they stand apart from moderate.
